messages:
Lena (AE): Heads-up — PulseHealth POC is ready to convert. They want 12mo committed capacity. Legal returned a DPA with three asks. Procurement also has e-invoicing requirements (Ariba / UBL). Need quick alignment so we can send final OF + DPA.

Owen (SE): Security notes: they require SAML SSO + SOC2. They also asked whether we can support customer-managed keys (BYOK) for cloud HSM during rollout. For now POC can use managed keys.

Marta (Legal): DPA redlines: (1) 30-day data export, (2) subprocessor approval, (3) liability cap = 2x fees. We can accept (1) & (2) with stronger security attestations, but liability cap needs Legal Lead sign-off. I'll prepare a minimal redline.

Diego (Procurement): PO/e-invoice items: legal entity full name + VAT/tax id, remit address, PO number, two authorized signers, and Ariba endpoint / UBL mapping if they want automated invoicing. They prefer DocuSign and want customer to sign first. Who collects signer names?

Lena (AE): I'll get signers. Proposed billing block for order form: 

Customer: PulseHealth Inc.
Billing contact: ap@pulsehealth.com
Remit: 12 Wellness Dr, Suite 210, Palo Alto, CA 94301
Tax/VAT: US-EIN 98-7654321
Term: 12 months
Commit: $90,000 / month
Billing terms: Net30
One-time onboarding credit: $7,500 applied to invoice #1
Signers: TBD (CFO + Head Procurement)

Ravi (Finance): Net30 OK. Add finance-billing@redwood.com to cc for PO routing. If they want Ariba/UBL, we need endpoint and PO-format sample before invoicing. Also add GL code field support if they require match.

Owen (SE): Propose adding this line to the OF: "BYOK via customer-managed cloud HSM available for Private deployments per separate SOW; not in scope for initial POC." Keeps scope clear.

Marta (Legal): Add e-sign clause: "Electronic signatures (DocuSign or equivalent) shall have the same legal effect as originals." Also, if exec sign-off on liability cap required, cc legallead (emma_r).

Diego (Procurement): Sequencing confirmation: customer signs OF + DPA -> Redwood countersigns -> customer issues PO referencing signed OF. If they insist on PO before countersign, we can accept but need to flag payment timing.

Ravi (Finance): If PO issued before countersign, invoice acceptance may be delayed; recommend "PO to follow" language so billing can proceed. Also request remit email and AP contact on the OF.

Lena (AE): I'll collect signer names and Ariba endpoint info. I'll update the OF with finance + BYOK note and send redlined DPA. Who should be cc'd on the send?

Marta (Legal): CC me + ops-privacy@redwood.com and priya@redwood.com. If liability cap exception needed, cc emma_r.

ops-privacy-bot: SOC2 report uploaded: https://redwood.internal/reports/soc2-2026

Lena (AE): Great — I'll send updated OF + DPA to PulseHealth legal today and post their response here. :thumbsup:
